newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lane Crawford Singapore operating loss HK$40 mln.
newsitem.headline: Lane Crawford Singapore operating loss HK$40 mln.

text.p: Lane Crawford International Ltd said on Tuesday it recorded a HK$40 million operating loss at its Singapore operation over the past six months.
Lane Crawford said earlier this month it would close its department store in Singapore at the end of this month.
The company said it would suspend its regional expansion following the Singapore experience but it was too early to say whether the company would record a loss for the full year to March 1997.
The company's Singapore store posted an operating loss of HK$132.5 million for the fiscal 1994/95, and at HK$60 million for 1995-96 after downsizing.
All the provisions made for the Singapore operations would be reflected in the accounts for the six months to September 30.
